result.title: Inducing Fourier Geometry: A Smoothness Prior Imposes Approximate Translation Equivariance in Multimodal Stellar Embeddings
result.summary: Learned representations often contain geometric structure induced by symmetries in the underlying data. We ask whether a known continuous parameter space can instead be used to \emph{induce} such structure when the corresponding symmetry is only approximate. We introduce a graph-Laplacian smoothness prior that encourages representations to vary smoothly over a physical parameter space without specifying a representation geometry; in the continuum limit it selects Laplacian eigenfunctions and therefore predicts the Fourier-like geometry associated with translation symmetry. On multimodal stellar representations spanning six astronomical surveys, the prior induces Toeplitz Gram structure and sinusoidal modes along stellar parameters, including in modalities whose native representations lack this geometry, while modality-specific residuals preserve structure outside the imposed coordinates. Of the exact-symmetry predictions, stationarity in a recoverable warped coordinate survives; diagnostics assuming exact quantization or asymptotic rates do not. The prior also improves downstream linear-probe performance and label efficiency, suggesting a general strategy: where a meaningful continuous parameter space exists, its local geometry can serve as a data-informed prior.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出在已知连续物理参数空间上施加图拉普拉斯平滑先验，不指定具体表征几何，却在连续极限下选出拉普拉斯特征函数，从而在六个天文巡源的多模态恒星表征中诱导出 Toeplitz Gram 结构与沿恒星参数的正弦模式，并提升下游线性探测与标签效率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「以平滑先验在连续参数空间上诱导表征几何（Laplacian 特征函数、近似平移等变性）」的思路，可能启发核查 latent 推理状态是否沿深度或位置轴呈现类似平滑几何结构、能否用先验塑造内部状态几何；这属较远领域的概念线索，与实际机制无关，可供核查。
